purpose: Represent sealed pre-FVD evidence as auditable search-allocation experience without embedding future holdout payloads or task-specific solver source.

proposal_profile_fields.mechanism_sequence: Sequence drawn only from the generic primitive vocabulary.
proposal_profile_fields.context_tags: Abstract applicability tags; no benchmark constants or task identities.
proposal_profile_fields.confirmed_causal_successes: Count parsed from sealed final audits.
proposal_profile_fields.performance_only_successes: Diagnostic non-causal successes; cannot be converted into causal credit.
proposal_profile_fields.risk_tags: Abstract conditions under which this class should lose allocation priority.
proposal_profile_fields.provenance: Exact repository paths and Git blob SHA-1s supporting the profile.

global_guard_semantics.semantic_equivalence_dedup_required: Equivalent implementations remain one mechanism class for causal accounting and should not consume duplicate exploration slots merely because labels differ.
global_guard_semantics.performance_is_not_causality: Large speedups without exclusive dependence on experience receive zero causal evidence weight.
global_guard_semantics.contaminated_or_diagnostic_only_records_: Contaminated/ineligible records may contribute safety lessons but never positive success evidence.
global_guard_semantics.predictive_signal_is_not_transfer: Cross-repository predictive accuracy alone is not evidence of unseen-mechanism/action transfer.
global_guard_semantics.strict_gate_exit_status_required: Scientific checker nonzero status is authoritative even if surrounding CI plumbing is green.

forbidden_content: future holdout tests or evaluator payloads
claim_boundary: This schema and any development artifact built under it are plumbing/apprenticeship infrastructure only. They are not causal-transfer evidence and do not start the official FVD holdout campaign.
